sentences.en: "I've finished" said Tony shortly, then he closed the piano.
sentences.zh: ‘我完成了。’托尼简短地说完后便关上了钢琴。

sentences.en: We're having a short maintenance break, we'll be back shortly!
sentences.zh: 我们稍作短暂维护，马上回来！

sentences.en: The bus will be here shortly. Please wait a bit.
sentences.zh: 公交车很快就到，请稍等片刻。
